title: Black Widow - Pink
lines: Don't judge a book by its cover. Beefed up with a Carbon Fiber Infused coverstock for the very first time, this Black Widow is ready to strike.
The Gas Mask core is the most iconic weight block in bowling. It is known for its large flare potential, versatility amongst bowling styles and its backend bite.
FACTORY FINISH 500/1000 Abralon Polished w/ Powerhouse Factory Finish Polish
BEST LANE CONDITION Medium to Heavy Oil
